title: "Hydromedusea (hydrom)"
format:
  html:
    code-fold: true
---


```{r setup, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE}
source("setup.R")
groups = names(default_groups())
coast = read_coast()
```

```{r read_ecomon, message=FALSE}
#| code-fold: false
thisgroup = "Hydromedusea"
nickname = "hydrom"
x = read_ecomon_spp(form = 'sf', groups = nickname, agg = FALSE) |>
  ecomon_to_long() |>
  dplyr::mutate(year = format(date, "%Y") ,
                month = factor(format(date, "%b"), levels = month.abb))
nonz = dplyr::filter(x, value > 0)
zero = dplyr::filter(x, value <= 0)
n = nrow(x)
nz = zero |> nrow()
coast = sf::st_crop(coast, x)
```

There are `r n` records for `r thisgroup` of which `r nz` are zeroes (about `r sprintf("%0.2f%%", nz/n*100)`) leaving `r n-nz` non-zero salp abundance records.
